statement: The quasi-Riemann hypothesis. Proves that every Dirichlet L-function, including $`\zeta(s)`$, is zero-free in $`\Re s\gt 7/8`$, resolving the quasi-Riemann hypothesis. The same half-plane is zero-free for every finite-order Hecke L-function over $`\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})`$. A companion gives a different proof of the zero-free half-plane $`\Re s\gt 11/12`$.
